svg.title: RiNGSiDE measured results
svg.desc: RiNGSiDE measured results. TP4 (RedHatAI checkpoint, lab plan 89dfef84): single-stream decode 105.3 code, 61.7 prose, 145.4 structured tok/s; cold prefill 1.7 s at 8K to 53.6 s at 256K; short code aggregate 77.0 tok/s at 1 stream to 345.8 tok/s at 16 streams; sparkDash code, 1 stream 151.3 tok/s; tool-eval-bench 96 in all 2 rounds (133/138 points each). TP2 (NVIDIA checkpoint, lab plan 69ad74fc): single-stream decode 56.5 code, 33.0 prose, 83.4 structured tok/s; cold prefill 3.6 s at 8K to 25.7 s at 64K; short code aggregate 44.0 tok/s at 1 stream to 97.3 tok/s at 6 streams; sparkDash code, 1 stream 85.7 tok/s.
